breakfast.name: Avocado Toast (Non Veg)
breakfast.description: A rich and creamy open toast made with buttery sourdough, smashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, and a perfectly fried egg. Finished with a drizzle of olive oil, a pinch of chili flakes, and fresh microgreens — a wholesome, flavour-packed breakfast that's as beautiful as it is satisfying.

breakfast.name: French Toast Cloud with Fruits, Berry Compote & Whipped Cream Cheese
breakfast.description: Thick, pillowy slices of milk bread soaked in a rich egg-cream batter and pan-fried to a golden, custard-like finish — served with a vibrant berry compote, fresh seasonal fruits, and a generous dollop of whipped cream cheese. A beautifully indulgent breakfast that balances tart, sweet, and creamy in every bite.

breakfast.name: Cream Cheese Soufflé Pancake
breakfast.description: Light, fluffy, and irresistibly soft — our Japanese-style soufflé pancake served with rich cream cheese, velvety whipped butter, and a generous drizzle of maple syrup. Made fresh to order and rising tall with a gentle wobble, each stack delivers that iconic melt-in-your-mouth texture that makes every bite truly unforgettable.

breakfast.name: Acai Bowl (Peanut butter)
breakfast.description: A refreshing, antioxidant-rich super bowl made with pure açaí, fresh fruits, and peanut butter — crowned with crunchy granola, banana slices, and fresh seasonal berries. A nourishing power bowl that keeps you going all day.

breakfast.name: Acai Bowl (Yogurt)
breakfast.description: A refreshing, antioxidant-rich super bowl made with pure açaí, fresh fruits, and creamy yogurt — a nourishing blend crowned with crunchy granola, banana slices, fresh seasonal berries, and a drizzle of honey. Light, vibrant, and energising — the perfect start to your day.

breakfast.name: Matcha Soufflé Pancake
breakfast.description: Cloud-light Japanese soufflé pancakes infused with vibrant ceremonial grade matcha — tall, airy, and delicately earthy. Topped with matcha cream, whipped butter, and a drizzle of maple syrup. Made fresh to order with that signature gentle wobble that makes each bite feel like a celebration.

breakfast.name: Chocolate Soufflé Pancake
breakfast.description: Airy, melt-in-your-mouth Japanese soufflé pancakes infused with rich cocoa — topped with chocolate sauce, whipped cream, and fresh berries. A chocolate lover's dream that arrives standing tall and delivers pure indulgence in every cloud-soft bite.

breakfast.name: French Toast Cloud (Plain)
breakfast.description: Thick, pillowy slices of milk bread soaked in a rich egg-cream batter and pan-fried to a golden, custard-like finish — soft and wobbly inside with a lightly caramelised crust. Simple, pure, and perfectly comforting.

ramen.name: PAN-GRILLED CHICKEN RAMEN (Thick or Thin broth)
ramen.description: Juicy, pan-grilled chicken thigh glazed in sweet teriyaki sauce served atop springy ramen noodles and a light, umami-rich thin broth. Each bowl is layered with vibrant toppings — palak, sweet corn, bamboo shoot pickle, mushrooms, and spring onion — and finished with an ajitama egg, nori, and a drizzle of garlic, onion, and chicken oils. A satisfying fusion of smoky, savory, and slightly sweet flavors that bring comfort in every spoonful.
ramen.contains: Chicken thigh, ramen noodles, thin broth, sweet teriyaki sauce, tare, palak, mushroom, bamboo shoot pickle & sauce, sweet corn, spring onion, ajitama egg, nori, chicken powder, garlic oil, onion oil, and chilli crisp.
ramen.allergens: Gluten, Soy, Egg, Sesame (from oil), Possible traces of shellfish (in sauces)

ramen.name: SPICY CHICKEN RAMEN (Thick or Thin Broth)
ramen.description: Tender chicken breast paired with fresh ramen noodles, simmered in a light yet flavorful spicy chicken broth. The bowl bursts with aroma from garlic, onion, and chicken oils, enriched with tare and kombu-shiitake liquid for deep umami. Topped with ajitama egg, sweet corn, palak, bamboo shoot pickle, mushrooms, and nori — it's a comforting balance of heat, savoriness, and texture in every bite.
ramen.contains: Chicken breast, ramen noodles, thin spicy chicken broth, chilli paste, tare, ajitama egg, palak, mushroom, bamboo shoot pickle & sauce, sweet corn, spring onion, garlic oil, onion oil, chicken oil, and nori.
ramen.allergens: Gluten, Soy, Egg, Sesame (from oil), Possible traces of shellfish (in sauces)

ramen.name: TOFU RAMEN (VEG BROTH)
ramen.description: Silky tofu cubes nestled in a creamy, plant-based broth made with oat milk, peanut butter, and kombu-shiitake liquid. The ramen is layered with earthy mushrooms, palak, sweet corn, bamboo shoot pickle, and spring onion — then drizzled with aromatic garlic and onion oils for extra depth. Finished with vegan butter, chilli paste, and crisp nori, this bowl offers a rich, nutty, and spicy harmony that's both comforting and wholesome.
ramen.contains: Tofu, ramen noodles, vegetable broth, oat milk, peanut butter, vegan butter, tare, palak, mushroom, bamboo shoot pickle & sauce, sweet corn, spring onion, garlic oil, onion oil, and chilli crisp.

ramen.name: Chicken Tantanmen Ramen
ramen.description: A rich, bold bowl of tantanmen-style ramen featuring a creamy sesame-chili broth, tender chicken, springy ramen noodles, and fragrant toppings. Inspired by classic Sichuan dan dan noodles with a Japanese-style chicken twist — nutty, spicy, and deeply satisfying in every spoonful.

ramen.name: Tofu Tantanmen Ramen
ramen.description: A plant-based take on the classic tantanmen — a rich sesame-chili broth with silky tofu, springy ramen noodles, and vibrant toppings. Deeply nutty, subtly spicy, and soul-warming from first sip to last. A bowl that shows plant-based ramen can be just as bold and satisfying.

ramen.name: Naruto Ramen
ramen.description: Named after the beloved anime, this special ramen bowl features a rich, umami-packed broth crowned with the iconic naruto fish cake, nori, ajitama egg, bamboo shoot, mushrooms, and spring onions. A fan-favourite bowl reimagined in our kitchen — bold, comforting, and full of character.

pokeBowls.name: SHRIMP POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: Juicy, marinated shrimp served with a vibrant mix of purple cabbage, cucumber, carrot, pickled radish, pickled ginger, avocado, sweet corn, edamame, fried onion, fried garlic, and seaweed salad — topped with furikake and served on a bed of rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice (keto-friendly).

pokeBowls.name: CHICKEN POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: Tender teriyaki-glazed chicken served over a bed of seasoned Japanese rice, topped with a colorful medley of purple cabbage, cucumber, carrot, pickled radish, and creamy avocado. Enhanced with edamame beans, sweet corn, seaweed salad, crispy fried onion and garlic, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Finished with a light dressing that ties together freshness, crunch, and umami in every bite.

pokeBowls.name: TUNA POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: Fresh, marinated tuna served with a colorful mix of purple cabbage, cucumber, carrot, pickled radish, pickled ginger, avocado, sweet corn, edamame, fried onion, fried garlic, and seaweed salad — topped with furikake and paired with rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice (keto-friendly).

pokeBowls.name: SALMON POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: Pan-seared salmon marinated in soy sauce, served with fresh veggies, creamy avocado, and furikake on a bed of rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice (keto-friendly).

pokeBowls.name: PANEER POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: A wholesome vegetarian delight featuring marinated paneer served with fresh, crunchy vegetables and creamy avocado — topped with furikake and paired with rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice (keto-friendly).

pokeBowls.name: TOFU POKE BOWL
pokeBowls.description: A wholesome, plant-based bowl featuring marinated tofu served with a colorful blend of purple cabbage, cucumber, carrot, pickled radish, pickled ginger, avocado, sweet corn, edamame, fried onion, fried garlic, and seaweed salad — topped with furikake and served on a bed of rice, quinoa, or cauliflower rice (keto-friendly).

appetizers.name: Takoyaki – Japanese Octopus Balls
appetizers.description: A savory Japanese street delight made with tender octopus pieces, crispy golden batter, a hint of dashi, and finished with light soy, spring onions, and crunchy crumbs — crispy outside, soft and flavorful inside.

appetizers.name: Chicken Katsu Finger
appetizers.description: Crispy golden chicken fingers coated in seasoned breadcrumbs, fried to perfection, and served with tangy katsu sauce and Japanese mayo. Tender and juicy on the inside, shatteringly crisp on the outside — a crowd-pleasing classic that hits every time.

appetizers.name: Prawn Tempura
appetizers.description: Crispy, golden-battered prawns fried to perfection — light, airy, and paired with a refreshing ponzu dipping sauce. A Japanese classic that's crunchy on the outside and tender inside.

appetizers.name: Chicken Karaage
appetizers.description: A Japanese classic — tender chicken marinated with soy, ginger, and garlic, lightly coated and fried to a perfect golden crisp. Juicy on the inside with an irresistibly crunchy exterior, served with Japanese mayo and a wedge of lemon. Simple, bold, and endlessly craveable.

appetizers.name: Seasonal Vegetable Tempura
appetizers.description: A crispy and light Japanese-style tempura made with seasonal vegetables — each piece coated in an airy batter and fried to a pale golden crisp. Served with a refreshing ponzu dipping sauce. An elegant vegetarian starter that celebrates the best of Japanese cooking.

appetizers.name: Paneer Katsu Finger
appetizers.description: Crispy golden fingers of paneer coated in seasoned breadcrumbs and served with tangy katsu sauce — a vegetarian twist on a Japanese classic. Each piece is fried to a satisfying crunch on the outside while remaining soft and creamy within. A delightful fusion of Indian and Japanese flavours.

appetizers.name: Teriyaki Tofu
appetizers.description: Pan-seared tofu glazed in a rich, savory-sweet teriyaki sauce and sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds — a clean, plant-based appetizer full of umami depth. Caramelised on the outside and silky within, it's a light yet deeply satisfying bite that pairs beautifully with steamed rice.

appetizers.name: Teriyaki Paneer
appetizers.description: Tender paneer cubes coated in a glossy teriyaki glaze and sprinkled with sesame seeds — a delightful East-meets-West fusion that brings together the richness of Indian cottage cheese with the sweet-savory depth of Japanese teriyaki. Pan-seared to a golden finish and served warm for a truly memorable bite.

appetizers.name: Chicken Teriyaki
appetizers.description: Our savory and delicious Chicken Teriyaki — a Japanese classic done right. Tender chicken thigh glazed in a rich, house-made teriyaki sauce, pan-grilled to caramelised perfection and finished with toasted sesame seeds and spring onions. Simple, elegant, and deeply satisfying in every bite.

appetizers.name: Tofu Katsu Finger
appetizers.description: Crispy golden tofu fingers coated in seasoned breadcrumbs and fried to perfection, served with tangy katsu sauce and Japanese mayo. A plant-based take on the beloved katsu — crunchy on the outside, tender on the inside, and packed with umami flavour in every bite.

appetizers.name: Chicken Gyoza / Dumplings
appetizers.description: Handcrafted crescent-shaped dumplings filled with seasoned chicken and vegetables — pan-fried to a golden crisp on one side and steamed to tender perfection on the other. Served with a light ponzu dipping sauce. A Japanese street food classic that's impossible to stop at just one.

appetizers.name: Katsu Chicken Sando / Sandwich
appetizers.description: Crispy katsu-fried chicken breast nestled in soft, pillowy milk bread with shredded cabbage, Japanese mayo, and tangy katsu sauce — a satisfying Japanese-style sandwich that delivers the perfect contrast of crunch and softness in every bite.

appetizers.name: Chicken Onigiri / Riceball
appetizers.description: Handmade Japanese rice balls filled with seasoned chicken and wrapped in crisp nori — compact, flavourful, and perfectly balanced. A wholesome snack or light bite rooted in Japanese everyday cooking.

appetizers.name: Tamago Sando / Egg Sandwich
appetizers.description: Soft, creamy Japanese egg salad generously sandwiched between pillowy milk bread — simple, comforting, and utterly irresistible. A beloved Tokyo convenience-store classic elevated with care and the finest ingredients.

appetizers.name: Cheese & Mushroom Gyoza
appetizers.description: Pan-fried dumplings filled with creamy cheese and earthy mushrooms — golden and crisp on the outside, gooey and flavourful within. A vegetarian gyoza that surprises and delights with every bite.

appetizers.name: Paneer Onigiri / Riceball
appetizers.description: Handcrafted Japanese-style rice balls filled with spiced paneer and wrapped in nori — a fusion of Japanese snacking culture and Indian cottage cheese. A light, flavourful bite that works perfectly as a starter or on-the-go snack.

appetizers.name: Katsu Tofu Sando / Sandwich
appetizers.description: Crispy katsu-fried tofu slabs nestled in soft milk bread with shredded cabbage, Japanese mayo, and tangy katsu sauce — a plant-based twist on the beloved Japanese sando. Satisfyingly crunchy, creamy, and full of umami in every bite.

donburi.name: Spicy Chicken Don / Rice Bowl
donburi.description: A hearty bowl of fluffy steamed rice topped with tender, spicy chicken breast, sautéed with garlic, onion, beans, and fiery bird's eye chilies. Finished with a soft ajitama egg and a sprinkle of spring onions, and served alongside a comforting miso soup with tofu, mushrooms, and bok choy.

donburi.name: Tofu Teriyaki Don / Rice Bowl
donburi.description: Golden pan-seared tofu glazed in rich teriyaki sauce, served over a bed of steamed rice with sautéed beans, garlic, onion, bird's eye chili, and spring onions. Accompanied by a warm miso soup with tofu, mushrooms, and bok choy — a comforting balance of sweetness, spice, and umami.

donburi.name: Egg & Vegetable Don / Rice Bowl
donburi.description: Fluffy golden omelette layered over fragrant rice stir-fried with garlic, onion, red capsicum, beans, mushrooms, and bok choy — finished with a drizzle of savory sauce, a touch of butter, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds and spring onions. Served with a warm, comforting bowl of miso soup with tofu, mushrooms, and bok choy.

donburi.name: Chicken Teriyaki Don / Rice Bowl
donburi.description: Tender pan-grilled chicken glazed in our house-made teriyaki sauce, served over fluffy steamed rice with sautéed vegetables, spring onions, and toasted sesame seeds. Accompanied by a warm bowl of miso soup with tofu, mushrooms, and bok choy — a simple, satisfying Japanese classic.

teaDesserts.name: Bubble Waffle
teaDesserts.description: Made fresh to order with a light, airy batter that bakes into iconic golden bubbles — crispy on the outside and fluffy within. Choose your sauce (caramel or chocolate) and add an ice cream topping (vanilla, chocolate, or strawberry) for +₹70. A sweet treat as fun to eat as it is beautiful.

teaDesserts.name: Cookies
teaDesserts.description: Freshly baked butter cookies with a melt-in-your-mouth crumb — golden, lightly crisp on the edges, and perfectly sweet. Ask our team for today's flavour.

bobaTea.name: Thai Tea Boba
bobaTea.description: Aromatic Thai tea brewed with warming spices and blended with condensed milk, topped with chewy tapioca pearls — sweet, bold, and distinctively orange. A creamy, indulgent boba classic.

bobaTea.name: Vietnamese Coffee Boba
bobaTea.description: Drip-brewed Vietnamese Robusta coffee blended with sweet condensed milk and served with chewy tapioca pearls over ice — rich, bold, and deeply satisfying. A coffee-lover's boba dream.

bobaTea.name: Matcha Tea Boba
bobaTea.description: Premium ceremonial grade matcha whisked with milk and served over ice with chewy tapioca pearls — earthy, creamy, and naturally energising. A refined boba for the matcha devoted.

bobaTea.name: Brown Sugar Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Creamy milk tea swirled with rich brown sugar syrup and loaded with chewy tapioca pearls — sweet, indulgent, and deeply comforting. A timeless boba favourite.

bobaTea.name: Caramel Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Smooth milk tea infused with golden caramel and served with chewy tapioca pearls over ice — buttery, sweet, and irresistibly creamy.

bobaTea.name: Chocolate Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Rich chocolate blended with creamy milk and served over ice with chewy tapioca pearls — a decadent, dessert-like boba that satisfies every chocolate craving.

bobaTea.name: Strawberry Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Fresh strawberry flavours blended with creamy milk and served with chewy tapioca pearls over ice — fruity, sweet, and beautifully pink.

bobaTea.name: Mango Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Tropical mango blended with smooth milk and served with chewy tapioca pearls over ice — bright, fruity, and refreshingly sweet.

bobaTea.name: Blueberry Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Juicy blueberry flavours swirled into creamy milk and served over ice with chewy tapioca pearls — subtly tart, sweet, and a beautiful deep purple hue.

bobaTea.name: Passion Fruit Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Refreshing green tea with tangy passion fruit popping boba pearls — each one bursting with tropical flavour in every sip. Light, energising, and vibrantly fruity.

bobaTea.name: Lychee Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Delicate green tea with fragrant lychee popping boba — each pearl bursting with the floral sweetness of fresh lychee. Light, refreshing, and subtly exotic.

bobaTea.name: Strawberry Matcha Tea Boba
bobaTea.description: A stunning layered drink of premium matcha and fresh strawberry flavours with chewy tapioca pearls — the perfect sweet-earthy combination in a glass.

bobaTea.name: Strawberry Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Crisp green tea paired with strawberry popping boba pearls that burst with fresh berry flavour — fruity, refreshing, and irresistibly fun to drink.

bobaTea.name: Mango Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Light green tea with tropical mango popping boba pearls that burst with sweet, sun-ripened flavour — refreshing, fruity, and endlessly enjoyable.

bobaTea.name: Peach Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Delicate green tea with sweet peach popping boba pearls — each one bursting with a gentle, orchard-fresh flavour. Light, summery, and irresistibly refreshing.

bobaTea.name: Passion Fruit & Peach Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: A vibrant green tea base loaded with passion fruit and peach popping boba — two tropical flavours that burst together in every sip for a refreshingly fruity experience.

bobaTea.name: Mango Matcha Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Premium matcha meets tropical mango popping boba in this vibrant, flavour-packed drink — earthy, fruity, and utterly refreshing. A uniquely satisfying combination that works beautifully together.

bobaTea.name: Taro Milk Boba
bobaTea.description: Creamy taro blended with smooth milk and served over ice with chewy tapioca pearls — subtly sweet, nutty, and unmistakably purple. A boba shop classic with a beautiful colour and comforting flavour.

bobaTea.name: Raspberry Popping Boba
bobaTea.description: Crisp green tea with tangy raspberry popping boba pearls that burst with bright berry flavour — refreshing, tart, and vibrantly fruity in every sip.

bobaTea.name: Peachy Fuzz
bobaTea.description: A sparkling, fruit-forward soda bursting with vibrant peach flavour — light, effervescent, and refreshingly sweet. The perfect thirst-quencher served ice cold.

bobaTea.name: Blush Fuzz
bobaTea.description: A sparkling blush-coloured fruity soda — light, effervescent, and beautifully refreshing. A delightful fizzy sipper served ice cold.

coffee.name: Espresso (Single Shot)
coffee.description: A pure, concentrated single shot (40ml) of rich espresso pulled from premium coffee beans — bold, full-bodied, and intensely aromatic. The foundation of all great coffee.

coffee.name: Espresso (Double Shot)
coffee.description: A double shot (80ml) of premium espresso — twice the depth, twice the richness. Bold, full-bodied, and perfectly concentrated for those who take their coffee seriously.

coffee.name: Vietnamese Coffee
coffee.description: Drip-brewed Robusta coffee mixed with sweetened condensed milk — rich, intensely bold, and deeply satisfying. A Vietnamese classic that's sweet, strong, and uniquely indulgent.

coffee.name: Americano
coffee.description: Espresso diluted with hot water to create a smooth, full-flavoured black coffee — clean, bold, and gently bitter. Simple, elegant, and endlessly drinkable.

coffee.name: Cappuccino
coffee.description: A classic Italian espresso topped with equal parts velvety steamed milk and thick, airy foam — balanced, comforting, and beautifully crafted in every cup.

coffee.name: Latte
coffee.description: Smooth espresso blended with a generous pour of steamed milk and a light layer of foam — creamy, mellow, and the perfect everyday coffee companion.

coffee.name: Mocha
coffee.description: A decadent blend of espresso, rich chocolate sauce, and steamed milk — a perfect harmony of coffee and cocoa finished with a light foam. Indulgent, warming, and impossible to resist.

coffee.name: Iced Espresso (Single Shot)
coffee.description: A single shot (100ml) of premium espresso served over ice — bold, refreshing, and perfectly chilled. Pure coffee intensity with an icy edge.

coffee.name: Iced Espresso (Double Shot)
coffee.description: A double shot (140ml) of premium espresso poured over ice — concentrated, bold, and ice-cold. For those who need their coffee strong and fast.

coffee.name: Iced Vietnamese Coffee
coffee.description: Chilled drip-brewed Robusta coffee with sweet condensed milk poured over ice — rich, bold, and deeply refreshing. The iconic Vietnamese cà phê sữa đá, served cold and perfect.

coffee.name: Iced Americano
coffee.description: Crisp, chilled espresso shots poured over ice with cold water — clean, bold, and endlessly refreshing. The perfect iced black coffee for a warm day.

coffee.name: Iced Cappuccino
coffee.description: Espresso combined with cold frothed milk served over ice — light, refreshing, and beautifully indulgent. The chilled cousin of the classic cappuccino.

coffee.name: Iced Latte
coffee.description: Creamy espresso and cold milk poured over ice — smooth, mellow, and endlessly satisfying. A café staple that never disappoints.

coffee.name: Iced Mocha
coffee.description: Espresso, rich chocolate sauce, and cold milk over ice — a chilled, chocolatey coffee treat that's indulgent and refreshing all at once.

coffee.name: Iced Orange Coffee
coffee.description: Freshly squeezed orange juice combined with espresso over ice — bright, citrusy, and boldly energising. A surprising combination that works beautifully together.

coffee.name: Iced Lime Coffee
coffee.description: Freshly squeezed lime juice with espresso over ice — tangy, refreshing, and uniquely bold. A zesty coffee experience that wakes up your senses.

coffee.name: Iced Coffee with French Vanilla
coffee.description: Smooth espresso over ice with a rich French vanilla flavour — sweet, creamy, and perfectly balanced. A classic flavoured iced coffee that feels like a treat.

coffee.name: Matcha Latte
coffee.description: Premium ceremonial grade matcha whisked to perfection with steamed milk — earthy, smooth, and vibrant. Available hot or iced, it's a nourishing and deeply satisfying alternative to coffee.

coffee.name: Matcha Iced Tea
coffee.description: Premium matcha dissolved in cold water and served over ice — clean, refreshing, and subtly earthy. A lighter, dairy-free way to enjoy the depth of ceremonial matcha.

coffee.name: Strawberry Matcha Latte
coffee.description: Premium matcha layered with fresh strawberry flavours and milk over ice — a beautiful sweet-earthy combination that's as stunning to look at as it is to drink.

coffee.name: Mango Matcha
coffee.description: Premium matcha blended with tropical mango over ice — vibrant, fruity, and refreshingly unique. The perfect balance of earthy green tea and sweet mango.

coffee.name: Thai Tea Latte
coffee.description: Aromatic Thai tea brewed with warming spices and blended with creamy milk — sweet, bold, and distinctively orange. Available hot or iced for the classic Thai tea experience.

coffee.name: Sumac Berry Tea
coffee.description: A warming herbal brew featuring sumac and berry — tangy, antioxidant-rich, and beautifully tart. A unique and healthful tea available hot or iced.

coffee.name: Fruity Roselle Tea
coffee.description: Hibiscus roselle tea — vibrant, tart, and naturally caffeine-free. Deeply ruby-red and packed with antioxidants, it's as beautiful as it is refreshing. Served hot or iced.

coffee.name: Forbidden Rice Tea
coffee.description: A unique tea brewed with black glutinous rice — nutty, earthy, and packed with antioxidants. Subtly sweet with a distinctive deep purple hue. Served hot or iced.
